EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_1 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE amount > abs(-500);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_1 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE ordered_at > now() - interval '30 days';

\echo [E3.2] Inlining a scalar SQL function; a SET clause blocks inlining
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_2 */ FUNCTION big_amount(numeric) RETURNS boolean
  LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE RETURN $1 > 900;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_2 */ FUNCTION big_amount_pinned(numeric) RETURNS boolean
  LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = pg_catalog RETURN $1 > 900;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_2 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE big_amount(amount);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_2 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE big_amount_pinned(amount);

\echo [E3.3] Inlining a set-returning SQL function; a PL/pgSQL one stays a function scan
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_3 */ FUNCTION orders_of(int) RETURNS SETOF orders LANGUAGE sql STABLE
  AS $$ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1 $$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_3 */ FUNCTION orders_of_plpgsql(int) RETURNS SETOF orders LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE
  AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1; END $$;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_3 */ SELECT * FROM orders_of(77) WHERE amount > 500;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_3 */ SELECT * FROM orders_of_plpgsql(77) WHERE amount > 500;

\echo [E3.4] Subquery pull-up; OFFSET 0 is an optimization fence
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_4 */
SELECT c.name, s.amount
  FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending') s
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
 WHERE c.region = 'west';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_4 */
SELECT c.name, s.amount
  FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' OFFSET 0) s
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
 WHERE c.region = 'west';
\echo [E3.4b] The fence keeps an outer qual out of the subquery, so the index cannot be used
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_4 */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM orders) s WHERE s.id = 42;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_4 */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM orders OFFSET 0) s WHERE s.id = 42;

\echo [E3.5] Outer-join reduction: a strict WHERE qual on the nullable side turns the LEFT JOIN into an inner join
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_5 */
SELECT c.name, o.amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE o.status = 'pending';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_5 */
SELECT c.name, o.amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'pending';

\echo [E3.6] Join removal: a LEFT JOIN to a unique key whose columns are not used is removed
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_6 */ SELECT o.id, o.amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_6 */ SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id;

\echo [E3.7] Equivalence classes: c.id = 42 and o.customer_id = c.id imply o.customer_id = 42
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_7 */ SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id = 42;

\echo [E3.8] NOT NULL columns: IS NOT NULL is dropped and IS NULL becomes constant false
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_8 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_8 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NULL;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_8 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE note IS NOT NULL;

\echo [E3.9] Volatility: a qual on a volatile output stays above the subquery; a qual on a plain column goes down
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_9 */
SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, amount, random() AS r FROM orders) s WHERE s.id = 5 AND s.r < 0.5;

\echo [E3.10] Security barrier views: a non-leakproof function runs after the quals of the view
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_10 */ FUNCTION leaky(int) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql COST 0.0000001
  AS $$ BEGIN RETURN true; END $$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_10 */ VIEW pending_plain AS
  SELECT id, customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_10 */ VIEW pending_sb WITH (security_barrier) AS
  SELECT id, customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_10 */ SELECT * FROM pending_plain WHERE leaky(id);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_10 */ SELECT * FROM pending_sb WHERE leaky(id);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_10 */ SELECT * FROM pending_sb WHERE id = 42;

\echo [E3.11] Row-level security: the policy becomes a qual that runs before a non-leakproof user function
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ ROLE pqt_reader;
ALTER /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ TABLE accounts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ POLICY IF EXISTS own_rows ON accounts;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ POLICY own_rows ON accounts FOR SELECT USING (owner = current_user);
GRANT /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ SELECT ON accounts TO pqt_reader;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ ROLE pqt_reader;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE balance > 5000;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE leaky(id);
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ ROLE;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_11 */ SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE leaky(id);

\echo [E3.12] Collations: an index on the database default collation cannot serve a comparison under "C"
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_12 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e3_12 */ INDEX customers_name_idx ON customers (name);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_12 */ SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'customer 0042';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_12 */ SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'customer 0042' COLLATE "C";
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e3_12 */;

\echo [E3.13] An OR that spans two tables: a one-table OR is extracted for each scan, and the full OR stays at the join
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e3_13 */
SELECT c.id, o.id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE (c.region = 'west' AND o.amount > 990) OR (c.tier = 'gold' AND o.amount < 5);
SQL
}

# s04: chapter 4, row and width estimates.
stage_s04() {
  say "s04: estimate rows and widths"
  pgf s04 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s04 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s04 */ TABLE IF EXISTS fresh, products;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s04 */ STATISTICS IF EXISTS customers_geo;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s04 */ FUNCTION IF EXISTS some_ids(), some_ids_50();
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s04 */ client_min_messages;

\echo [E4.1] The stored inputs: pg_class sizes and the per-column statistics of orders
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_1 */ relname, relpages, reltuples, relallvisible
  FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname IN ('customers', 'orders', 'items') ORDER BY relname;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_1 */ attname, null_frac, avg_width, n_distinct, correlation,
       array_length(most_common_vals::text::text[], 1) AS n_mcv,
       array_length(histogram_bounds::text::text[], 1) AS n_hist
  FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'orders' ORDER BY attname;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_1 */ attname, most_common_vals, most_common_freqs
  FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'orders' AND attname = 'status';
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_1 */ attname, most_common_vals, most_common_freqs
  FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'customers' AND attname IN ('region', 'country')
 ORDER BY attname;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_1 */ (most_common_vals::text::int[])[1:5] AS first_mcvs,
       (most_common_freqs)[1:5] AS first_freqs,
       (SELECT sum(f) FROM unnest(most_common_freqs) f) AS mcv_total_freq
  FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'orders' AND attname = 'customer_id';
\echo [E4.1b] The histogram bucket of orders.amount that contains 250.00
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_1b */ i AS bucket_lower_index, b[i] AS lower_bound, b[i + 1] AS upper_bound,
       array_length(b, 1) AS n_bounds
  FROM (SELECT histogram_bounds::text::numeric[] AS b FROM pg_stats
         WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'orders' AND attname = 'amount') s,
       generate_series(1, array_length(b, 1) - 1) i
 WHERE b[i] <= 250.00 AND b[i + 1] > 250.00;
\echo [E4.1c] The MCV list of orders.amount: its total frequency and the part below 250.00
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_1c */ array_length(most_common_freqs, 1) AS n_mcv,
       (SELECT sum(f) FROM unnest(most_common_freqs) f) AS mcv_total_freq,
       (SELECT coalesce(sum(u.f), 0) FROM unnest(most_common_vals::text::numeric[], most_common_freqs) AS u(v, f)
         WHERE u.v < 250.00) AS mcv_freq_below_250
  FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'orders' AND attname = 'amount';

\echo [E4.2] MCV equality: status = pending
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_2 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';
\echo [E4.3] Histogram range: amount < 250
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount < 250;
\echo [E4.4] Equality on a value inside the MCV list, then one outside it
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 7;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 500;
\echo [E4.4b] The inputs of those two estimates: the MCV frequency of 7, the rarest MCV, and the non-MCV remainder
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_4 */ u.f AS freq_of_7,
       (SELECT min(x) FROM unnest(s.most_common_freqs) x) AS least_mcv_freq,
       array_length(s.most_common_freqs, 1) AS n_mcv,
       (SELECT sum(x) FROM unnest(s.most_common_freqs) x) AS mcv_total_freq,
       s.n_distinct, s.null_frac
  FROM pg_stats s, unnest(s.most_common_vals::text::int[], s.most_common_freqs) AS u(v, f)
 WHERE s.schemaname = 'public' AND s.tablename = 'orders' AND s.attname = 'customer_id' AND u.v = 7;
\echo [E4.5] NULL fraction
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_5 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE note IS NOT NULL;
\echo [E4.6] Two dependent columns: the independence assumption, then extended statistics
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE region = 'west' AND country = 'PT';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT region, country, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY region, country;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ STATISTICS customers_geo (dependencies, ndistinct, mcv) ON region, country FROM customers;
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ customers;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ statistics_name, n_distinct, dependencies
  FROM pg_stats_ext WHERE statistics_name = 'customers_geo';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE region = 'west' AND country = 'PT';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT region, country, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY region, country;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ STATISTICS customers_geo;
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e4_6 */ customers;

\echo [E4.7] Join size with a foreign key: every order matches exactly one customer
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_7 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_7 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'west';
\echo [E4.8] Join size without a foreign key: eqjoinsel matches the two MCV lists
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e4_8 */ TABLE products AS SELECT g AS id, 'product ' || g AS name FROM generate_series(1, 500) g;
ALTER /* wiki_pqt_e4_8 */ TABLE products ADD PRIMARY KEY (id);
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e4_8 */ products;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_8 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id;
\echo [E4.8b] A skewed self-join, run serially so that its counters repeat (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e4_8 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_8 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.product_id = a.product_id;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e4_8 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather;

\echo [E4.9] Grouping estimate: the number of groups is n_distinct of the column
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_9 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

\echo [E4.10] Missing statistics: a table that was never analyzed
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e4_10 */ TABLE fresh AS SELECT g AS x, g % 10 AS y FROM generate_series(1, 10000) g;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_10 */ relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'fresh';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_10 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM fresh;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_10 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM fresh WHERE y = 3;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_10 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM fresh WHERE x < 100;
\echo [E4.11] Stale statistics: rows added after ANALYZE are scaled from the file size, not from the histogram
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ fresh;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'fresh';
INSERT /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ INTO fresh SELECT g, g % 10 FROM generate_series(10001, 20000) g;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ relpages, reltuples, pg_relation_size('fresh') / 8192 AS current_pages
  FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'fresh';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM fresh;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM fresh WHERE x > 10000;
\echo [E4.11b] The last histogram bounds of fresh.x, as ANALYZE stored them before the INSERT
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ array_length(histogram_bounds::text::int[], 1) AS n_bounds,
       (histogram_bounds::text::int[])[99:101] AS last_bounds
  FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'fresh' AND attname = 'x';
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ INDEX fresh_x_idx ON fresh (x);
\echo [E4.11c] CREATE INDEX rewrote the stored size of fresh
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class
 WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'fresh';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_11 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM fresh WHERE x > 10000;

\echo [E4.12] Function row estimates: support functions, the prorows default, and ROWS
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e4_12 */ FUNCTION some_ids() RETURNS SETOF int LANGUAGE plpgsql
  AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT 1; END $$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e4_12 */ FUNCTION some_ids_50() RETURNS SETOF int LANGUAGE plpgsql ROWS 50
  AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT 1; END $$;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_12 */ SELECT * FROM generate_series(1, 250) g;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_12 */ SELECT * FROM unnest(ARRAY[1, 2, 3, 4]) u;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_12 */ SELECT * FROM some_ids();
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_12 */ SELECT * FROM some_ids_50();

\echo [E4.13] Pattern matching: LIKE with a fixed prefix
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_13 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'customer 01%';
\echo [E4.13b] The histogram bounds of customers.name around the prefix
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_13 */ array_length(histogram_bounds::text::text[], 1) AS n_bounds,
       (histogram_bounds::text::text[])[5:11] AS bounds_5_to_11
  FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'customers' AND attname = 'name';
\echo [E4.14] An expression without statistics gets a default selectivity; an expression index adds statistics
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_14 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount * 2 > 1000;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_14 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM customers WHERE lower(name) = 'customer 0042';
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_14 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e4_14 */ INDEX orders_amount_x2 ON orders ((amount * 2));
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e4_14 */ orders;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_14 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount * 2 > 1000;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e4_14 */;
\echo [E4.15] Width: the plan width is the sum of the average column widths
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e4_15 */ attname, avg_width FROM pg_stats
 WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'orders' ORDER BY attname;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e4_15 */ SELECT id, status, note FROM orders;
SQL
}

# s05: chapter 5, costs.
stage_s05() {
  say "s05: estimate costs"
  pgf s05 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s05 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s05 */ FUNCTION IF EXISTS slow_check(numeric);
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s05 */ client_min_messages;
\echo [E5.1] The inputs of the cost of a sequential scan
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e5_1 */ relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'orders';
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e5_1 */ name, setting FROM pg_settings
 WHERE name IN ('seq_page_cost', 'random_page_cost', 'cpu_tuple_cost', 'cpu_index_tuple_cost',
                'cpu_operator_cost', 'effective_cache_size', 'work_mem') ORDER BY name;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_1 */ SELECT * FROM orders;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_1 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_1 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND amount < 250;
\echo [E5.2] Startup and total cost; LIMIT takes a fraction of the run cost of its input
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders LIMIT 10;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount LIMIT 10;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_2 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount LIMIT 10;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_2 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount;
\echo [E5.3] A sort under a small work_mem: planned as an external sort, run as one (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_3 */ work_mem = '64kB';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_3 */ SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount;
\echo [E5.4] Grouping under the same work_mem: the planner prices the hash spill and picks sorted input (forced setting)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
\echo [E5.4b] With the index paths switched off as well, the spilling HashAggregate is chosen and splits into batches while running (forced settings)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ enable_indexonlyscan = off;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ enable_indexscan = off;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ enable_bitmapscan = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ enable_indexonlyscan;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ enable_indexscan;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ enable_bitmapscan;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ work_mem;
\echo [E5.4c] The same grouping at the default work_mem
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
\echo [E5.5] Function cost orders the quals: the expensive function runs last
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e5_5 */ FUNCTION slow_check(numeric) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE COST 1000
  AS $$ BEGIN RETURN $1 >= 0; END $$;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_5 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE slow_check(amount) AND status = 'pending';
\echo [E5.6] Row-count clamping: an estimate below one row is raised to one
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_6 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 500 AND status = 'cancelled' AND amount < 1;
\echo [E5.7] disable_cost: enable_seqscan = off cannot remove the only path (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_7 */ enable_seqscan = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_7 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE note = 'gift wrap';
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_7 */ enable_seqscan;
\echo [E5.8] random_page_cost moves the index-versus-heap balance (forced setting)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 100 AND 1000;
\echo [E5.8b] The plain index scan the planner rejected at random_page_cost = 4 (forced settings)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ enable_bitmapscan = off;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ enable_seqscan = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 100 AND 1000;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ enable_seqscan;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ enable_bitmapscan;
\echo [E5.8c] The same query at random_page_cost = 1.1 (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ random_page_cost = 1.1;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 100 AND 1000;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_8 */ random_page_cost;
\echo [E5.9] Repeated inner index scans priced with effective_cache_size 4GB and then 8kB (forced settings)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ enable_hashjoin = off;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ enable_mergejoin = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ SELECT c.id, o.amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE c.region = 'west' AND c.tier = 'gold';
SET /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ effective_cache_size = '8kB';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ SELECT c.id, o.amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE c.region = 'west' AND c.tier = 'gold';
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ effective_cache_size;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ enable_hashjoin;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e5_9 */ enable_mergejoin;
SQL
}

# s06: chapter 6, scan alternatives.
stage_s06() {
  say "s06: generate scan alternatives"
  pgf s06 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ TABLE IF EXISTS ios, audit_plans;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ FUNCTION IF EXISTS capture_transition_plan();
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ FOREIGN TABLE IF EXISTS products_csv;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ SERVER IF EXISTS files;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS tsm_system_rows;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS file_fdw;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s06 */ client_min_messages;

\echo [E6.1] Sample scans: SYSTEM samples pages, BERNOULLI samples rows, SYSTEM_ROWS comes from an extension
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_1 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (10) REPEATABLE (42);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_1 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_1 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM_ROWS (25);

\echo [E6.2] Index scan and index-only scan
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_2 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = 42;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_2 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id < 1000;

\echo [E6.3] Index-only scans check the visibility map while running; the planner used the stored relallvisible
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ TABLE ios AS SELECT id, amount FROM orders;
ALTER /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ TABLE ios ADD PRIMARY KEY (id);
VACUUM /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ (ANALYZE) ios;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ relpages, relallvisible FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'ios';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT id FROM ios WHERE id <= 3000;
UPDATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ ios SET amount = amount + 0 WHERE id % 50 = 0;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ relpages, relallvisible FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'ios';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT id FROM ios WHERE id <= 3000;
VACUUM /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ ios;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ relpages, relallvisible FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'ios';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT id FROM ios WHERE id <= 3000;

\echo [E6.4] Bitmap scans: one index, then BitmapOr over two indexes
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 7;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 7 OR ordered_at < '2024-01-02';
\echo [E6.4b] On orders, an AND of two conditions uses one index and a filter
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 7 AND ordered_at < '2024-03-01';
\echo [E6.4c] On the larger events table, two uncorrelated indexes are combined with BitmapAnd
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */ INDEX events_kind_idx ON events (kind);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */ INDEX events_order_mod_idx ON events ((order_id % 97));
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */ events;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind = 3 AND order_id % 97 = 5;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e6_4 */;

\echo [E6.5] TID scan and TID range scan
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_5 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE ctid = '(10,1)';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_5 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE ctid < '(5,0)';
\echo [E6.5b] A parameterized TID scan: each outer row supplies the TID to fetch
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_5 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT o.id FROM (VALUES ('(0,1)'::tid), ('(3,2)'::tid)) AS v(t) JOIN orders o ON o.ctid = v.t;

\echo [E6.6] Function, table-function and values scans
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_6 */ SELECT * FROM generate_series(1, 10) WITH ORDINALITY AS g(v, n);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_6 */ SELECT * FROM ROWS FROM (generate_series(1, 3), unnest(ARRAY['a', 'b'])) AS r(n, s);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_6 */
SELECT * FROM JSON_TABLE('[{"a": 1}, {"a": 2}]'::jsonb, '$[*]' COLUMNS (a int PATH '$.a')) AS jt;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_6 */
SELECT c.id, v.label FROM (VALUES ('north', 'N'), ('west', 'W')) AS v(region, label)
  JOIN customers c ON c.region = v.region;

\echo [E6.7] Subquery scan: a subquery with OFFSET keeps its own plan and the outer filter stays outside
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_7 */
SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id OFFSET 0) s WHERE n > 400;

\echo [E6.8] CTE scan and worktable scan
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_8 */
WITH big AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 990)
SELECT count(*) FROM big WHERE status = 'pending';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_8 */
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 10) SELECT * FROM r;

\echo [E6.9] Named tuplestore scan: a statement trigger plans a query over its transition table
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_9 */ TABLE audit_plans (seq serial, line text);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_9 */ FUNCTION capture_transition_plan() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE r record;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_9 */ SELECT count(*) FROM newrows' LOOP
    INSERT /* wiki_pqt_e6_9 */ INTO audit_plans(line) VALUES (r."QUERY PLAN");
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_9 */ TRIGGER ios_audit AFTER INSERT ON ios REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS newrows
  FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION capture_transition_plan();
INSERT /* wiki_pqt_e6_9 */ INTO ios SELECT id + 100000, amount FROM ios WHERE id <= 10;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e6_9 */ line FROM audit_plans ORDER BY seq;

\echo [E6.10] Foreign scan: file_fdw reads a CSV file written into the sandbox
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_10 */ SERVER files FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER file_fdw;
\set csvpath :outdir '/products.csv'
COPY /* wiki_pqt_e6_10 */ (SELECT g AS id, 'product ' || g AS name FROM generate_series(1, 500) g)
  TO :'csvpath' WITH (FORMAT csv);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e6_10 */ FOREIGN TABLE products_csv (id int, name text)
  SERVER files OPTIONS (filename :'csvpath', format 'csv');
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_10 */ (COSTS ON) SELECT * FROM products_csv WHERE id < 10;

\echo [E6.11] Result nodes: no table at all, a constant-false qual, and a pseudoconstant gating qual
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_11 */ SELECT 1 + 1;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_11 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE false;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e6_11 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE now() > '2000-01-01' AND customer_id = 7;
SQL
}

# s07: chapter 7, index usefulness.  The deliberate CREATE UNIQUE INDEX
# CONCURRENTLY failure runs through pgerr, between two SQL files.
stage_s07() {
  say "s07: decide whether an index is useful"
  pgf s07 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s07 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s07 */ INDEX IF EXISTS orders_status_uq;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s07 */ client_min_messages;
\echo [E7.1] Access-method and index-column capabilities, from the catalog
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ amname,
       pg_indexam_has_property(oid, 'can_order') AS can_order,
       pg_indexam_has_property(oid, 'can_unique') AS can_unique,
       pg_indexam_has_property(oid, 'can_multi_col') AS can_multi_col,
       pg_indexam_has_property(oid, 'can_exclude') AS can_exclude,
       pg_indexam_has_property(oid, 'can_include') AS can_include
  FROM pg_am WHERE amtype = 'i' ORDER BY amname;
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ INDEX am_btree ON places USING btree (id);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ INDEX am_hash ON places USING hash (name);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ INDEX am_gist ON places USING gist (p);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ INDEX am_spgist ON places USING spgist (p);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ INDEX am_gin ON docs USING gin (tags);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ INDEX am_brin ON places USING brin (id);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */ i::text AS index,
       pg_index_has_property(i, 'index_scan') AS index_scan,
       pg_index_has_property(i, 'bitmap_scan') AS bitmap_scan,
       pg_index_has_property(i, 'backward_scan') AS backward_scan,
       pg_index_column_has_property(i, 1, 'orderable') AS orderable,
       pg_index_column_has_property(i, 1, 'distance_orderable') AS distance_orderable,
       pg_index_column_has_property(i, 1, 'returnable') AS returnable,
       pg_index_column_has_property(i, 1, 'search_array') AS search_array,
       pg_index_column_has_property(i, 1, 'search_nulls') AS search_nulls
  FROM unnest(ARRAY['am_btree', 'am_hash', 'am_gist', 'am_spgist', 'am_gin', 'am_brin']::regclass[]) AS i;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_1 */;

\echo [E7.2] B-tree: range, ordering, backward scan, IN list, cross-type operator, and an expression it cannot use
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2024-06-01' AND ordered_at < '2024-06-02';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY ordered_at DESC LIMIT 5;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (500, 501, 502);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = 42::bigint;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id + 0 = 42;

\echo [E7.3] A multicolumn index: equality on the first column serves ORDER BY on the second, and a condition on the second column alone loses to a sequential scan
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */ INDEX orders_cust_time ON orders (customer_id, ordered_at);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 7 ORDER BY ordered_at DESC LIMIT 3;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */ INDEX orders_ordered_at_idx;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE ordered_at = '2024-06-01 00:00:00+00';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */ SELECT customer_id, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE ordered_at = '2024-06-01 00:00:00+00';
\echo [E7.3b] The full-index path on the second column exists; it only costs more (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */ LOCAL enable_seqscan = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */ SELECT customer_id, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE ordered_at = '2024-06-01 00:00:00+00';
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_3 */;

\echo [E7.4] IS NOT NULL is a B-tree search condition
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_4 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_4 */ INDEX orders_note_idx ON orders (note);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_4 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE note IS NOT NULL;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_4 */;

\echo [E7.5] Hash index: equality only
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_5 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_5 */ INDEX customers_email_hash ON customers USING hash (email);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_5 */ SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email = 'user42@example.com';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_5 */ SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email > 'user99';
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_5 */;

\echo [E7.6] GiST and SP-GiST: containment and nearest-neighbour ordering
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */ INDEX places_p_gist ON places USING gist (p);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */ SELECT * FROM places WHERE p <@ box '((100,100),(120,120))';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT id, p FROM places ORDER BY p <-> point '(500,500)' LIMIT 5;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */;
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */ INDEX places_p_spgist ON places USING spgist (p);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */ SELECT * FROM places WHERE p <@ box '((100,100),(120,120))';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */ SELECT id, p FROM places ORDER BY p <-> point '(500,500)' LIMIT 5;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_6 */;

\echo [E7.7] GIN supports bitmap scans only; with enable_bitmapscan off its one path carries disable_cost and the sequential scan wins (forced setting)
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_7 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_7 */ INDEX docs_tags_gin ON docs USING gin (tags);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_7 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT * FROM docs WHERE tags @> ARRAY['t7'];
SET /* wiki_pqt_e7_7 */ LOCAL enable_bitmapscan = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_7 */ SELECT * FROM docs WHERE tags @> ARRAY['t7'];
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_7 */;

\echo [E7.8] BRIN: block ranges are lossy, so every heap row is rechecked
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_8 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE at >= '2024-03-01' AND at < '2024-03-02';

\echo [E7.9] Expression index: lower(email) matches only the same expression
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_9 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_9 */ INDEX customers_lower_email ON customers (lower(email));
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_9 */ SELECT * FROM customers WHERE lower(email) = 'user42@example.com';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_9 */ SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email = 'user42@example.com';
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_9 */;

\echo [E7.10] Partial index: usable only when the query provably implies its predicate
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ INDEX orders_pending_cust ON orders (customer_id) WHERE status = 'pending';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND customer_id = 700;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped' AND customer_id = 700;
PREPARE /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ p_status(text, int) AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = $1 AND customer_id = $2;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ LOCAL plan_cache_mode = force_generic_plan;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ EXECUTE p_status('pending', 700);
SET /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ LOCAL plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ EXECUTE p_status('pending', 700);
DEALLOCATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */ p_status;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_10 */;

\echo [E7.11] Covering index: an INCLUDE column makes an index-only scan possible
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_11 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_11 */ INDEX orders_cust_incl ON orders (customer_id) INCLUDE (amount);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_11 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 700;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_11 */;

\echo [E7.12] Support functions turn LIKE with a prefix and range containment into index conditions
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_12 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_12 */ INDEX customers_name_idx ON customers (name);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_12 */ SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'customer 01%';
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_12 */;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_12 */
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE ordered_at <@ tstzrange('2024-06-01 00:00+00', '2024-06-02 00:00+00');

\echo [E7.13] Parameterized index path: the inner index scan takes its key from each outer row
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_13 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT c.name, o.amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.id BETWEEN 500 AND 504;

\echo [E7.14] A valid index on status, for comparison with the invalid one below
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */ INDEX orders_status_idx ON orders (status);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */;
SQL
  printf '[E7.14b] CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY on a column with duplicates fails and leaves an invalid index\n' >> "$OUT/s07.txt"
  pgerr "CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */ UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY orders_status_uq ON orders (status);" \
        "could not create unique index" >> "$OUT/s07.txt" || die "the failing index build did not fail as expected"
  pgf s07b <<'SQL'
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */ indexrelid::regclass AS index, indisvalid, indisready
  FROM pg_index WHERE indexrelid = 'orders_status_uq'::regclass;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';
DROP /* wiki_pqt_e7_14 */ INDEX orders_status_uq;
SQL
  cat "$OUT/s07b.txt" >> "$OUT/s07.txt" && rm -f "$OUT/s07b.txt" "$OUT/s07b.err"
}

# s08: chapter 8, joins.
stage_s08() {
  say "s08: search join orders and methods"
  pgf s08 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s08 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s08 */ TABLE IF EXISTS j01, j02, j03, j04, j05, j06, j07, j08, j09, j10, j11, j12;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s08 */ client_min_messages;

\echo [E8.1] Q2: three tables and a grouping
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_1 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT c.region, count(*) AS lines, sum(i.qty * i.price) AS revenue
  FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id
 WHERE o.status = 'pending'
 GROUP BY c.region;

\echo [E8.2] One join priced with each method in turn (forced settings)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_2 */ SELECT o.id, i.qty FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'pending';
SET /* wiki_pqt_e8_2 */ enable_hashjoin = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_2 */ SELECT o.id, i.qty FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'pending';
SET /* wiki_pqt_e8_2 */ enable_mergejoin = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_2 */ SELECT o.id, i.qty FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'pending';
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e8_2 */ enable_hashjoin;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e8_2 */ enable_mergejoin;

\echo [E8.3] Merge join over two presorted index scans
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_3 */ SELECT o.id, i.line_no FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20;

\echo [E8.4] Memoize: a parameterized inner scan whose keys repeat, run serially so that its counters repeat (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e8_4 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.product_id = a.product_id WHERE a.order_id <= 2000;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e8_4 */ enable_memoize = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_4 */ SELECT count(*) FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.product_id = a.product_id WHERE a.order_id <= 2000;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e8_4 */ enable_memoize;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e8_4 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather;

\echo [E8.5] Materialize: a nested loop without a hashable or mergeable clause rescans a materialized inner
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_5 */
SELECT count(*) FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 999) o ON o.amount > c.id;

\echo [E8.6] Outer, full, semi and anti joins
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_6 */
SELECT c.id, count(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_6 */
SELECT c.id, o.id FROM customers c FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 999) o ON o.customer_id = c.id;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_6 */
SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'cancelled');
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_6 */
SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.amount > 990);

\echo [E8.7] A semi join whose inner side is made unique first, and one reduced to an inner join
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_7 */ SELECT * FROM orders o WHERE o.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM items WHERE product_id = 3);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_7 */
SELECT * FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'west' AND tier = 'gold');

\echo [E8.8] join_collapse_limit = 1 keeps the written JOIN order (forced setting)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_8 */
SELECT count(*) FROM items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
 WHERE c.region = 'west' AND c.tier = 'gold';
SET /* wiki_pqt_e8_8 */ join_collapse_limit = 1;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_8 */
SELECT count(*) FROM items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
 WHERE c.region = 'west' AND c.tier = 'gold';
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e8_8 */ join_collapse_limit;

\echo [E8.9] GEQO: twelve relations in one FROM list reach geqo_threshold; written as JOINs they do not
DO /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ $$
BEGIN
  FOR t IN 1..12 LOOP
    EXECUTE format('CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ TABLE j%s (id int PRIMARY KEY, next_id int NOT NULL, v int NOT NULL)',
                   lpad(t::text, 2, '0'));
    EXECUTE format('INSERT /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ INTO j%s SELECT g, 1 + (g * %s) %% 1000, g %% %s FROM generate_series(1, 1000) g',
                   lpad(t::text, 2, '0'), 7 + t, 3 + t);
    EXECUTE format('ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ j%s', lpad(t::text, 2, '0'));
  END LOOP;
END $$;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ name, setting FROM pg_settings
 WHERE name IN ('geqo', 'geqo_threshold', 'geqo_seed', 'join_collapse_limit', 'from_collapse_limit') ORDER BY name;
\echo [E8.9a] Written as twelve explicit JOINs: join_collapse_limit = 8 splits the search, so GEQO is never reached
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ plan_summary($q$
SELECT count(*) FROM j01 JOIN j02 ON j02.id = j01.next_id JOIN j03 ON j03.id = j02.next_id
  JOIN j04 ON j04.id = j03.next_id JOIN j05 ON j05.id = j04.next_id JOIN j06 ON j06.id = j05.next_id
  JOIN j07 ON j07.id = j06.next_id JOIN j08 ON j08.id = j07.next_id JOIN j09 ON j09.id = j08.next_id
  JOIN j10 ON j10.id = j09.next_id JOIN j11 ON j11.id = j10.next_id JOIN j12 ON j12.id = j11.next_id
 WHERE j01.v = 1$q$) AS explicit_joins;
\echo [E8.9b] The same twelve tables in one FROM list: the genetic search runs
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ plan_summary($q$
SELECT count(*) FROM j01, j02, j03, j04, j05, j06, j07, j08, j09, j10, j11, j12
 WHERE j02.id = j01.next_id AND j03.id = j02.next_id AND j04.id = j03.next_id AND j05.id = j04.next_id
   AND j06.id = j05.next_id AND j07.id = j06.next_id AND j08.id = j07.next_id AND j09.id = j08.next_id
   AND j10.id = j09.next_id AND j11.id = j10.next_id AND j12.id = j11.next_id AND j01.v = 1$q$) AS geqo_search;
\echo [E8.9c] The same FROM list with geqo = off: the exhaustive dynamic-programming search (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ geqo = off;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ plan_summary($q$
SELECT count(*) FROM j01, j02, j03, j04, j05, j06, j07, j08, j09, j10, j11, j12
 WHERE j02.id = j01.next_id AND j03.id = j02.next_id AND j04.id = j03.next_id AND j05.id = j04.next_id
   AND j06.id = j05.next_id AND j07.id = j06.next_id AND j08.id = j07.next_id AND j09.id = j08.next_id
   AND j10.id = j09.next_id AND j11.id = j10.next_id AND j12.id = j11.next_id AND j01.v = 1$q$) AS exhaustive_search;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e8_9 */ geqo;

\echo [E8.10] Hash join batches: a small work_mem splits the hash table while running (forced setting)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_10 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled';
SET /* wiki_pqt_e8_10 */ work_mem = '64kB';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e8_10 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled';
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e8_10 */ work_mem;
SQL
}

# s09: chapter 9, subqueries and CTEs.
stage_s09() {
  say "s09: plan subqueries and CTEs"
  pgf s09 <<'SQL'
\echo [E9.1] Uncorrelated scalar subquery: an InitPlan, run once
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_1 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE amount > (SELECT avg(amount) FROM orders);

\echo [E9.2] Correlated scalar subquery: a SubPlan, run once per outer row
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_2 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT c.id, (SELECT max(o.amount) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS top_amount
  FROM customers c WHERE c.region = 'west' AND c.tier = 'gold';

\echo [E9.3] IN (subquery) becomes a semi join
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_3 */
SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE c.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled');

\echo [E9.4] NOT IN stays a hashed SubPlan, because of its NULL semantics; NOT EXISTS becomes an anti join
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_4 */
SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE c.id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled');
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_4 */
SELECT * FROM customers c
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'cancelled');

\echo [E9.5] ANY over an array is an index condition; ALL over a subquery is a SubPlan
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_5 */ SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = ANY (ARRAY[500, 501, 502]);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_5 */
SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE c.id > ALL (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 999.9);

\echo [E9.6] A correlated IN whose correlation refers only to the outer query level becomes a semi join
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_6 */
SELECT * FROM customers c
 WHERE c.id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.amount > c.id * 0.4);

\echo [E9.7] LATERAL: each outer row is fed into the subquery
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_7 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT c.id, t.amount
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT amount FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 2) t
 WHERE c.region = 'west' AND c.tier = 'gold';

\echo [E9.8] CTEs: inlined when referenced once, materialized when MATERIALIZED or referenced twice
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_8 */
WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending') SELECT * FROM p WHERE id = 42;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_8 */
WITH p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending') SELECT * FROM p WHERE id = 42;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_8 */
WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending')
SELECT * FROM p a JOIN p b ON b.id = a.id + 1 WHERE a.id = 42;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_8 */
WITH p AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending')
SELECT * FROM p a JOIN p b ON b.id = a.id + 1 WHERE a.id = 42;

\echo [E9.9] A materialized CTE passes its column statistics to the outer estimate
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_9 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
WITH m AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT customer_id FROM orders) SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE customer_id = 7;

\echo [E9.10] Recursive CTE: RecursiveUnion over a worktable; recursive_worktable_factor sizes the estimate (forced setting)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_10 */
WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, depth) AS (
  SELECT id, 1 FROM customers WHERE id = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, chain.depth + 1 FROM chain JOIN customers c ON c.id = chain.id + 1 WHERE chain.depth < 50)
SELECT count(*) FROM chain;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e9_10 */ recursive_worktable_factor = 100;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_10 */
WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, depth) AS (
  SELECT id, 1 FROM customers WHERE id = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, chain.depth + 1 FROM chain JOIN customers c ON c.id = chain.id + 1 WHERE chain.depth < 50)
SELECT count(*) FROM chain;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e9_10 */ recursive_worktable_factor;

\echo [E9.11] A correlated EXISTS under OR cannot become a join: it stays a SubPlan; with 2000 outer rows setrefs keeps the hashed alternative
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_11 */
SELECT c.id FROM customers c
 WHERE c.region = 'west'
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'cancelled');
\echo [E9.11b] With one outer row to test, setrefs keeps the per-row EXISTS SubPlan instead
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e9_11 */
SELECT c.id FROM customers c
 WHERE c.id = 42
   AND (c.tier = 'gold' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id));
SQL
}

# s10: chapter 10, operations above scans and joins.
stage_s10() {
  say "s10: plan operations above scans and joins"
  pgf s10 <<'SQL'
\echo [E10.1] A set-returning function in the select list: ProjectSet
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_1 */ SELECT id, generate_series(1, 3) AS n FROM customers WHERE id <= 2;

\echo [E10.2] Incremental sort: an index supplies the first sort key
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_2 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, amount DESC LIMIT 10;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e10_2 */ enable_incremental_sort = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_2 */ SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, amount DESC LIMIT 10;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e10_2 */ enable_incremental_sort;

\echo [E10.3] HashAggregate for few groups; sorted grouping when the output must be ordered
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_3 */ SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_3 */ SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;

\echo [E10.4] Presorted aggregates: ORDER BY inside the aggregate is met by sorting the input (and the forced alternative)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_4 */ SELECT customer_id, array_agg(amount ORDER BY amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e10_4 */ enable_presorted_aggregate = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_4 */ SELECT customer_id, array_agg(amount ORDER BY amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e10_4 */ enable_presorted_aggregate;

\echo [E10.5] GROUP BY key order: with hashing off, the keys are reordered to match the index order (forced settings)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_5 */ SELECT status, customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status, customer_id;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e10_5 */ enable_hashagg = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_5 */ SELECT status, customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status, customer_id;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e10_5 */ enable_group_by_reordering = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_5 */ SELECT status, customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status, customer_id;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e10_5 */ enable_group_by_reordering;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e10_5 */ enable_hashagg;

\echo [E10.6] Grouping sets: ROLLUP and CUBE
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_6 */ SELECT region, tier, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY ROLLUP (region, tier);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_6 */ SELECT region, tier, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY CUBE (region, tier);

\echo [E10.7] MIN and MAX become index probes; without an index they stay aggregates
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_7 */ SELECT min(ordered_at), max(ordered_at) FROM orders;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_7 */ SELECT max(amount) FROM orders;

\echo [E10.8] Window functions, and a run condition derived from row_number
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_8 */
SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.amount,
                      row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn
                 FROM orders o) s
 WHERE rn <= 2;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_8 */ SELECT id, sum(amount) OVER (ORDER BY ordered_at) FROM orders LIMIT 5;

\echo [E10.9] DISTINCT and DISTINCT ON
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_9 */ SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_9 */
SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id, id, amount FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, amount DESC;

\echo [E10.10] Set operations
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_10 */
SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' UNION SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'west';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_10 */
SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'west';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_10 */
SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' INTERSECT SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'west';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_10 */
SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' EXCEPT SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'west';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_10 */
SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id < 100 UNION SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id BETWEEN 50 AND 150 ORDER BY 1;

\echo [E10.11] LIMIT and OFFSET
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_11 */ SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY ordered_at LIMIT 10 OFFSET 1000;

\echo [E10.12] HAVING: a condition without aggregates moves into WHERE
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e10_12 */
SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING customer_id < 10 AND count(*) > 400;
SQL
}

# s11: chapter 11, inheritance and partitioning.  plan_summary(), from the
# schema stage, keeps a 256-partition plan to one line.
stage_s11() {
  say "s11: handle inheritance and partitioning"
  pgf s11 <<'SQL'
\echo [E11.1] Plan-time pruning with constants
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_1 */
SELECT count(*) FROM orders_r WHERE ordered_at >= '2024-03-01' AND ordered_at < '2024-04-01';

\echo [E11.2] No qual on the partition key: every partition is scanned
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_2 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders_r WHERE customer_id = 7;

\echo [E11.3] Initial pruning in a generic plan: partitions removed at executor startup (forced plan_cache_mode)
PREPARE /* wiki_pqt_e11_3 */ month_count(timestamptz) AS
  SELECT count(*) FROM orders_r WHERE ordered_at >= $1 AND ordered_at < $1 + interval '1 month';
SET /* wiki_pqt_e11_3 */ plan_cache_mode = force_generic_plan;
\echo [E11.3b] Plain EXPLAIN runs executor startup too, so the initial pruning already shows
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_3 */ EXECUTE month_count('2024-03-01');
\echo [E11.3c] The same generic plan executed
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) EXECUTE month_count('2024-03-01');
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e11_3 */ plan_cache_mode;
DEALLOCATE /* wiki_pqt_e11_3 */ month_count;

\echo [E11.4] Execution-time pruning: an InitPlan result prunes partitions while running
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM orders_r WHERE ordered_at >= (SELECT max(ordered_at) FROM orders) - interval '10 days';
\echo [E11.4b] Execution-time pruning inside a nested loop: each outer row selects its partition
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_4 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*)
  FROM (VALUES (timestamptz '2024-03-05 00:00:00+00'), (timestamptz '2024-07-09 00:00:00+00')) AS v(t)
  JOIN orders_r o ON o.ordered_at = v.t;

\echo [E11.5] Constraint exclusion on legacy inheritance, then switched off (forced setting)
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_5 */ SELECT count(*) FROM ledger WHERE yr = 2024;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e11_5 */ constraint_exclusion = off;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_5 */ SELECT count(*) FROM ledger WHERE yr = 2024;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e11_5 */ constraint_exclusion;

\echo [E11.6] Partitionwise join: off by default, then forced on
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_6 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders_h o JOIN items_h i ON i.order_id = o.id;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e11_6 */ enable_partitionwise_join = on;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_6 */ SELECT count(*) FROM orders_h o JOIN items_h i ON i.order_id = o.id;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e11_6 */ enable_partitionwise_join;

\echo [E11.7] Partitionwise aggregation, full and partial (forced on)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e11_7 */ enable_partitionwise_aggregate = on;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_7 */ SELECT id, count(*) FROM orders_h GROUP BY id;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_7 */ SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders_h GROUP BY status;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e11_7 */ enable_partitionwise_aggregate;

\echo [E11.8] Ordered output: a live default partition forces a MergeAppend even in partition-key order
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_8 */ SELECT * FROM orders_r ORDER BY ordered_at LIMIT 5;
\echo [E11.8b] With the default partition pruned, the range partitions are read in bound order by a plain Append
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_8 */
SELECT * FROM orders_r WHERE ordered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY ordered_at LIMIT 5;
\echo [E11.8c] Any other order needs a MergeAppend
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e11_8 */ SELECT * FROM orders_r ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 5;

\echo [E11.9] Planning overhead: 256 partitions, all kept, pruned to one, and pruning switched off (forced)
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e11_9 */ plan_summary('SELECT count(*) FROM wide_p') AS all_partitions;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e11_9 */ plan_summary('SELECT count(*) FROM wide_p WHERE id = 42') AS pruned;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e11_9 */ enable_partition_pruning = off;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e11_9 */ plan_summary('SELECT count(*) FROM wide_p WHERE id = 42') AS pruning_off;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e11_9 */ enable_partition_pruning;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e11_9 */ plan_summary('SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE id = 42') AS plain_table;
SQL
}

# s12: chapter 12, parallel query and JIT.
stage_s12() {
  say "s12: plan parallel execution and JIT"
  pgf s12 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s12 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s12 */ FUNCTION IF EXISTS kind_unsafe(smallint), kind_restricted(smallint);
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s12 */ client_min_messages;
\echo [E12.1] Parallel sequential scan under partial and final aggregation
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_1 */ relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'events';
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_1 */ name, setting FROM pg_settings
 WHERE name IN ('max_parallel_workers_per_gather', 'max_parallel_workers', 'max_worker_processes',
                'min_parallel_table_scan_size', 'min_parallel_index_scan_size',
                'parallel_setup_cost', 'parallel_tuple_cost', 'parallel_leader_participation')
 ORDER BY name;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_1 */ SELECT count(*) FROM events;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_1 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT kind, count(*) FROM events GROUP BY kind;

\echo [E12.2] The parallel_workers storage parameter overrides the size rule (forced settings)
ALTER /* wiki_pqt_e12_2 */ TABLE events SET (parallel_workers = 4);
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_2 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 4;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_2 */ SELECT count(*) FROM events;
ALTER /* wiki_pqt_e12_2 */ TABLE events RESET (parallel_workers);
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_2 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather;

\echo [E12.3] A small inner side: each process builds its own private copy of the hash table
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT o.status, count(*) FROM events e JOIN orders o ON o.id = e.order_id GROUP BY o.status;
\echo [E12.3b] A large inner side: Parallel Hash, one hash table shared by all processes
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_3 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT count(*) FROM events e1 JOIN events e2 ON e2.id = e1.id;

\echo [E12.4] Gather Merge keeps the sorted order of the workers output
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_4 */ SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY payload LIMIT 10;

\echo [E12.5] Parallel index-only and parallel bitmap heap scans
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_5 */;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e12_5 */ INDEX events_order_id_idx ON events (order_id);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_5 */ SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE order_id < 20000;
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e12_5 */;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_5 */ SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE at >= '2024-02-01' AND at < '2024-05-01';

\echo [E12.6] Parallel Append over the two branches of a UNION ALL
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_6 */
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM events WHERE kind = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM events WHERE kind = 2) s;

\echo [E12.7] Parallel safety: an unsafe function anywhere keeps the whole plan serial
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e12_7 */ FUNCTION kind_unsafe(smallint) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql PARALLEL UNSAFE
  AS $$ BEGIN RETURN $1 < 5; END $$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e12_7 */ FUNCTION kind_restricted(smallint) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql PARALLEL RESTRICTED
  AS $$ BEGIN RETURN $1 < 5; END $$;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_7 */ SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind_unsafe(kind);
\echo [E12.7b] A restricted function in a scan qual keeps that scan out of the workers
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_7 */ SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind_restricted(kind);
\echo [E12.7c] A restricted function in the select list is evaluated by the leader, above Gather
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_7 */ (VERBOSE) SELECT kind_restricted(kind) FROM events WHERE id < 100;

\echo [E12.8] max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0 disables parallel plans (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_8 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_8 */ SELECT count(*) FROM events;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_8 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather;

\echo [E12.9] debug_parallel_query forces a Gather over a serial plan to test parallel safety (forced setting)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_9 */ debug_parallel_query = on;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_9 */ SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE region = 'west';
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_9 */ debug_parallel_query;

\echo [E12.10] JIT: the planner sets PlannedStmt.jitFlags from the plan cost; this build has no JIT provider
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ pg_jit_available();
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ name, setting FROM pg_settings
 WHERE name IN ('jit', 'jit_above_cost', 'jit_inline_above_cost', 'jit_optimize_above_cost',
                'jit_expressions', 'jit_tuple_deforming', 'jit_provider')
 ORDER BY name;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ debug_print_plan = on;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ client_min_messages = log;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0;
DO /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ $$ BEGIN RAISE LOG 'marker e12_10_default_costs'; END $$;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ count(*) FROM events;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit_above_cost = 10;
DO /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ $$ BEGIN RAISE LOG 'marker e12_10_above_cost_10'; END $$;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ count(*) FROM events;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit_optimize_above_cost = 10;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit_inline_above_cost = 10;
DO /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ $$ BEGIN RAISE LOG 'marker e12_10_all_thresholds_10'; END $$;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ count(*) FROM events;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit = off;
DO /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ $$ BEGIN RAISE LOG 'marker e12_10_jit_off'; END $$;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ count(*) FROM events;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ client_min_messages;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ debug_print_plan;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit;
\echo [E12.10b] With the thresholds still at 10, EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows no JIT section, because nothing was compiled
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT count(*) FROM events;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit_above_cost;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit_optimize_above_cost;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ jit_inline_above_cost;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e12_10 */ max_parallel_workers_per_gather;
SQL
  debug_capture s12
}

# s13: chapter 13, writes and row locking.  Statements on the running schema
# are only EXPLAINed, never run: even a rolled-back write leaves the table file
# larger, and the planner scales its row estimates by the file size, so a run
# would change the numbers of every later stage.  The executed writes run on
# orders_w, a disposable copy of orders.
stage_s13() {
  say "s13: plan writes and row locking"
  pgf s13 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ TABLE IF EXISTS orders_archive, staging, orders_w;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ client_min_messages;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ TABLE orders_w (LIKE orders INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ INTO orders_w SELECT * FROM orders;
VACUUM /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ (ANALYZE) orders_w;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ TABLE orders_archive (LIKE orders INCLUDING ALL);
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ TABLE staging AS
  SELECT id, amount + 1 AS amount FROM orders WHERE id % 100 = 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 30000 + g, 5.00 FROM generate_series(1, 50) g;
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_s13 */ staging;

\echo [E13.1] INSERT ... SELECT
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_1 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
INSERT INTO orders_archive SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

\echo [E13.2] INSERT ... ON CONFLICT: the arbiter index is chosen while planning
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_2 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
INSERT INTO orders AS o (id, customer_id, status, ordered_at, amount)
VALUES (1, 1, 'pending', '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00', 1.00)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET amount = o.amount + excluded.amount;

\echo [E13.3] UPDATE with a join: the scan returns the row identity (ctid) and the new column values
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_3 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
UPDATE orders o SET amount = o.amount * 1.1 FROM customers c
 WHERE c.id = o.customer_id AND c.region = 'west' AND o.status = 'pending';

\echo [E13.4] DELETE ... RETURNING
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_4 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND amount < 1 RETURNING id, amount;

\echo [E13.5] MERGE: planned as a join between the source and the target
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_5 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
MERGE INTO orders o USING staging s ON o.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET amount = s.amount
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, customer_id, status, ordered_at, amount)
  VALUES (s.id, 1, 'pending', '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00', s.amount);

\echo [E13.6] A data-modifying CTE is planned as its own subplan and run to completion once
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_6 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
WITH moved AS (DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND amount < 5 RETURNING *)
INSERT INTO orders_archive SELECT * FROM moved;

\echo [E13.7] UPDATE on a partitioned table: pruning limits the result relations; a key change moves rows
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_7 */ (COSTS OFF)
UPDATE orders_r SET amount = amount + 1 WHERE ordered_at >= '2024-03-01' AND ordered_at < '2024-03-02';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_7 */ (COSTS OFF)
UPDATE orders_r SET ordered_at = ordered_at + interval '1 month' WHERE id = 5;

\echo [E13.8] INSERT into a partitioned table: the executor routes each row
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_8 */ (COSTS OFF)
INSERT INTO orders_r VALUES (99999, 1, 'pending', '2024-05-05 00:00:00+00', 1.00, NULL);

\echo [E13.9] UPDATE on an inheritance parent updates every child
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_9 */ (COSTS OFF) UPDATE ledger SET amount = amount + 1 WHERE amount < 10;

\echo [E13.10] Row locking: FOR UPDATE adds a LockRows node; FOR UPDATE OF locks one side of a join
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_10 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 500 FOR UPDATE;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_10 */ (VERBOSE, COSTS OFF)
SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
 WHERE o.customer_id = 500 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED;

\echo [E13.11] Executed writes on the copy orders_w, each rolled back: actual row counts
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_11 */;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_11 */ (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
UPDATE orders_w o SET amount = o.amount * 1.1 FROM customers c
 WHERE c.id = o.customer_id AND c.region = 'west' AND o.status = 'pending';
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e13_11 */;
BEGIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_11 */;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e13_11 */ (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
MERGE INTO orders_w o USING staging s ON o.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET amount = s.amount
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, customer_id, status, ordered_at, amount)
  VALUES (s.id, 1, 'pending', '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00', s.amount);
ROLLBACK /* wiki_pqt_e13_11 */;
SQL
}

# s14: chapter 14, plan caching.  pg_stat_statements was loaded at server
# start with track = all and track_planning = on, so its plans column counts
# every call of the planner for a statement, nested ones included.
stage_s14() {
  say "s14: build, cache, and invalidate plans"
  pgf s14 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s14 */ client_min_messages = warning;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_s14 */ EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;
-- Every other stage runs with compute_query_id = off, so that EXPLAIN VERBOSE
-- prints no OID-dependent query identifier; pg_stat_statements needs one.
SET /* wiki_pqt_s14 */ compute_query_id = on;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s14 */ FUNCTION IF EXISTS count_plpgsql(int), count_sql(int), count_sql_batch(int), count_dynamic(int);
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s14 */ INDEX IF EXISTS orders_note_idx;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s14 */ TABLE IF EXISTS stale_t;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s14 */ client_min_messages;

\echo [E14.1] A prepared statement: five custom plans, then the generic plan when it is not dearer
PREPARE /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ by_id(int) AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = $1;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ EXECUTE by_id(1);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ by_id(1);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ by_id(2);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ by_id(3);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ by_id(4);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ name, generic_plans, custom_plans FROM pg_prepared_statements WHERE name = 'by_id';
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ by_id(5);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ name, generic_plans, custom_plans FROM pg_prepared_statements WHERE name = 'by_id';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ EXECUTE by_id(6);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_1 */ name, generic_plans, custom_plans FROM pg_prepared_statements WHERE name = 'by_id';

\echo [E14.2] A skewed parameter: the generic plan uses an average estimate
PREPARE /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ by_cust(int) AS SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ EXECUTE by_cust(7);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ EXECUTE by_cust(500);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ by_cust(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ by_cust(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ by_cust(7);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ name, generic_plans, custom_plans FROM pg_prepared_statements WHERE name = 'by_cust';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ EXECUTE by_cust(7);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_2 */ name, generic_plans, custom_plans FROM pg_prepared_statements WHERE name = 'by_cust';
\echo [E14.3] plan_cache_mode forces either kind of plan (forced settings)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e14_3 */ plan_cache_mode = force_generic_plan;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_3 */ EXECUTE by_cust(7);
SET /* wiki_pqt_e14_3 */ plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_3 */ EXECUTE by_cust(7);
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e14_3 */ plan_cache_mode;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_3 */ (GENERIC_PLAN) SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1;

\echo [E14.4] Invalidation: a new index replans the cached statement
PREPARE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ by_note(text) AS SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE note = $1;
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ by_note('gift wrap');
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ by_note('gift wrap');
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ by_note('gift wrap');
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ by_note('gift wrap');
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ by_note('gift wrap');
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ EXECUTE by_note('gift wrap');
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ INDEX orders_note_idx ON orders (note);
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ EXECUTE by_note('gift wrap');
DROP /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ INDEX orders_note_idx;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ EXECUTE by_note('gift wrap');
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ name, generic_plans, custom_plans FROM pg_prepared_statements WHERE name = 'by_note';
DEALLOCATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_4 */ ALL;

\echo [E14.5] Planner calls counted by pg_stat_statements, per plan-reuse boundary
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ FUNCTION count_plpgsql(p int) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN (SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_plpgsql */ count(*) FROM orders WHERE id = p);
END $$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ FUNCTION count_sql(p int) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql AS $$
  SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_sqlfunc */ count(id) FROM orders WHERE id = p
$$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ FUNCTION count_sql_batch(p int) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql AS $$
  SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_sqlbatch */ count(customer_id) FROM orders WHERE id = p
$$;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ FUNCTION count_dynamic(p int) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE n bigint;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_dynamic */ count(amount) FROM orders WHERE id = $1' INTO n USING p;
  RETURN n;
END $$;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ pg_stat_statements_reset() IS NOT NULL AS reset;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(1);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(2);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(3);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(4);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(5);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(6);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(7);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(8);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(9);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_plpgsql(10);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_sql(1);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_sql(2);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_sql(3);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_sql(4);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_sql(5);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ sum(count_sql_batch(g)) FROM generate_series(1, 10) g;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_dynamic(1);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_dynamic(2);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_dynamic(3);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_dynamic(4);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_dynamic(5);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ count_dynamic(6);
PREPARE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_prepared */ sp AS SELECT count(*) FROM orders;
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ sp;
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ sp;
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ sp;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ search_path = public, pg_catalog;
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5_call */ sp;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ search_path;
DEALLOCATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ sp;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_5 */ toplevel, calls, plans,
       regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS query
  FROM pg_stat_statements
 WHERE query ~ 'wiki_pqt_e14_5_(plpgsql|sqlfunc|sqlbatch|dynamic|prepared)'
 ORDER BY query, toplevel;

\echo [E14.6] ANALYZE and a cached generic plan: unchanged statistics keep the plan, a changed row count replans it
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ TABLE stale_t AS SELECT * FROM orders;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ INDEX stale_t_customer_id_idx ON stale_t (customer_id);
VACUUM /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ (ANALYZE) stale_t;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ pg_stat_statements_reset() IS NOT NULL AS reset;
PREPARE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_prepared */ sp2(int) AS SELECT count(*) FROM stale_t WHERE customer_id = $1;
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ 'after 7 executions' AS step, s.calls, s.plans, p.generic_plans, p.custom_plans
  FROM pg_stat_statements s, pg_prepared_statements p
 WHERE s.query ~ 'wiki_pqt_e14_6_prepared' AND p.name = 'sp2';
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ stale_t;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class
 WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'stale_t';
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ 'after an ANALYZE that changed no size' AS step, s.calls, s.plans, p.generic_plans, p.custom_plans
  FROM pg_stat_statements s, pg_prepared_statements p
 WHERE s.query ~ 'wiki_pqt_e14_6_prepared' AND p.name = 'sp2';
INSERT /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ INTO stale_t SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 7;
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ stale_t;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class
 WHERE relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND relname = 'stale_t';
EXECUTE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6_call */ sp2(7);
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ 'after an ANALYZE that changed the row count' AS step, s.calls, s.plans, p.generic_plans, p.custom_plans
  FROM pg_stat_statements s, pg_prepared_statements p
 WHERE s.query ~ 'wiki_pqt_e14_6_prepared' AND p.name = 'sp2';
DEALLOCATE /* wiki_pqt_e14_6 */ sp2;
SQL
}

# s15: chapter 15, extension interfaces.  The postgres_fdw server is a
# loopback connection to this same sandbox cluster, over its own socket.
stage_s15() {
  say "s15: extend and navigate the planner"
  pgf s15 <<'SQL'
SET /* wiki_pqt_s15 */ client_min_messages = warning;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s15 */ SCHEMA IF EXISTS remote CASCADE;
DROP /* wiki_pqt_s15 */ SERVER IF EXISTS loopback CASCADE;
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_s15 */ EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgres_fdw;
RESET /* wiki_pqt_s15 */ client_min_messages;

\echo [E15.1] postgres_fdw: joins and aggregates pushed to the remote server
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ SERVER loopback FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER postgres_fdw
  OPTIONS (host :'sockdir', port :'port', dbname :'dbname');
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ USER MAPPING FOR postgres SERVER loopback OPTIONS (user 'postgres');
CREATE /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ SCHEMA remote;
IMPORT /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ FOREIGN SCHEMA public LIMIT TO (customers, orders) FROM SERVER loopback INTO remote;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ relname, relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class
 WHERE relnamespace = 'remote'::regnamespace ORDER BY relname;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ (VERBOSE)
SELECT c.region, count(*) FROM remote.orders o JOIN remote.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
 WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY c.region;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ (VERBOSE) SELECT id FROM remote.orders WHERE amount > 999;
\echo [E15.1b] After ANALYZE samples the remote table, and with use_remote_estimate
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ remote.orders;
ANALYZE /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ remote.customers;
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ relname, relpages, reltuples FROM pg_class
 WHERE relnamespace = 'remote'::regnamespace ORDER BY relname;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ (VERBOSE) SELECT id FROM remote.orders WHERE amount > 999;
ALTER /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ SERVER loopback OPTIONS (ADD use_remote_estimate 'true');
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ (VERBOSE) SELECT id FROM remote.orders WHERE amount > 999;
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e15_1 */ (VERBOSE)
SELECT c.region, count(*) FROM remote.orders o JOIN remote.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
 WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY c.region;

\echo [E15.2] Planner-facing catalog entries: operator estimators, merge and hash support
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e15_2 */ o.oid::regoperator AS operator, o.oprrest, o.oprjoin, o.oprcanmerge, o.oprcanhash
  FROM pg_operator o
 WHERE o.oid IN ('=(int4,int4)'::regoperator, '<(numeric,numeric)'::regoperator,
                 '~~(text,text)'::regoperator, '@>(anyarray,anyarray)'::regoperator,
                 '<->(point,point)'::regoperator, '<@(anyelement,anyrange)'::regoperator,
                 '<@(point,box)'::regoperator)
 ORDER BY 1;
\echo [E15.3] Planner-facing function attributes: support function, cost, rows, volatility, parallel safety, leakproofness
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e15_3 */ p.oid::regprocedure AS function, p.prosupport, p.procost, p.prorows,
       p.provolatile, p.proparallel, p.proleakproof
  FROM pg_proc p
 WHERE p.oid IN ('generate_series(int4,int4)'::regprocedure, 'unnest(anyarray)'::regprocedure,
                 'textlike(text,text)'::regprocedure, 'row_number()'::regprocedure,
                 'elem_contained_by_range(anyelement,anyrange)'::regprocedure,
                 'int4eq(int4,int4)'::regprocedure, 'random()'::regprocedure, 'now()'::regprocedure,
                 'texteq(text,text)'::regprocedure)
 ORDER BY 1;
\echo [E15.4] Aggregates that can run in parallel need a combine function; MIN and MAX name a sort operator
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e15_4 */ a.aggfnoid::regprocedure AS aggregate, a.aggcombinefn, a.aggserialfn,
       a.aggsortop::regoperator AS sortop
  FROM pg_aggregate a
 WHERE a.aggfnoid IN ('count("any")'::regprocedure, 'sum(numeric)'::regprocedure, 'avg(numeric)'::regprocedure,
                      'max(timestamptz)'::regprocedure, 'array_agg(anynonarray)'::regprocedure,
                      'string_agg(text,text)'::regprocedure)
 ORDER BY 1;
SQL
}

# s16: chapter 16, diagnosing planner decisions.
stage_s16() {
  say "s16: diagnose planner decisions"
  pgf s16 <<'SQL'
\echo [E16.1] Planner settings and the scope in which each can be changed
SELECT /* wiki_pqt_e16_1 */ name, setting, unit, context, category
  FROM pg_settings
 WHERE category LIKE 'Query Tuning%'
    OR name IN ('work_mem', 'hash_mem_multiplier', 'max_parallel_workers_per_gather', 'max_parallel_workers',
                'parallel_leader_participation', 'debug_parallel_query', 'effective_io_concurrency',
                'geqo_seed', 'jit_expressions', 'jit_tuple_deforming', 'jit_provider',
                'debug_print_plan', 'compute_query_id')
 ORDER BY category, name;

\echo [E16.2] EXPLAIN (SETTINGS) names the planner settings that differ from their defaults (forced settings)
SET /* wiki_pqt_e16_2 */ random_page_cost = 1.1;
SET /* wiki_pqt_e16_2 */ work_mem = '16MB';
EXPLAIN /* wiki_pqt_e16_2 */ (SETTINGS)
SELECT c.name, o.id, o.amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
